name: Rychvald (Czechia)
description: Four horizontal stripes of white, navy blue, white and navy blue in the ratio 4:1:1:1, with a navy blue linden sprig of three leaves in the upper white.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 7 May 1992 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
